summary: Iteration scope review completed for feedback iteration 1. The current iteration is internally consistent and technically ready within the Registration intake boundary: all six planned story ids are preserved across the plan, elaborated requirements, and test design; requirements remain scoped to customer Google/GitHub OAuth registration, Prisma/PostgreSQL identity persistence, database sessions, sign-in UI, failure handling, and verification coverage; out-of-scope items such as administrator authorization, passwords, customer profile enrichment, and manual account linking are clearly excluded. Evidence reviewed includes the intake, baseline plan, requirements artifact, test-design artifact, Auth.js route/configuration, sign-in page, Prisma schema, migration, and package dependencies. Verification commands run successfully: `npm.cmd ls next-auth @auth/core @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma --depth=0`, `npx.cmd prisma validate`, `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`, and `npm.cmd run lint`. No Playwright/browser tests were run during this scope review, so browser behavior is not claimed as executed.
